tasks.title: Measure performance baseline
tasks.goal: Define the user/system metric and collect repeatable pre-change measurements.
acceptance: Metric, workload, environment and measurement method are explicit.
Baseline has enough repetitions or profiling evidence to be meaningful.

tasks.title: Locate dominant bottleneck
tasks.goal: Use runtime evidence to identify where time, CPU, memory, I/O or contention is actually spent.
acceptance: Bottleneck claim is supported by profile/trace/metric evidence.
Optimization is aimed at dominant cost rather than intuition.
verification: Preserve profile/trace artifact and causal explanation.

tasks.title: Define bounded optimization hypothesis
tasks.goal: Choose one change with an expected measurable effect and explicit guardrails.
acceptance: Expected metric direction and acceptance threshold are written before implementation.

tasks.title: Implement optimization
tasks.goal: Make the smallest change that tests the hypothesis.
acceptance: Change is attributable to the stated hypothesis.
No unrelated optimization bundle obscures causality.
verification: Inspect diff and retain rollback path.

tasks.title: Remeasure under same conditions
tasks.goal: Repeat the baseline method and compare distributions/profiles, not anecdotes.
acceptance: Target metric meets threshold or change is rejected.
verification: Store before/after measurements and exact commands.

tasks.title: Review performance tradeoffs
tasks.goal: Look for hidden correctness, memory, scalability, complexity or maintainability regressions.
acceptance: Performance gain survives correctness and maintainability review.
